entities.summary: Georg-Ludwig von Breitenbuch is a German politician. A member of the Christian Democratic Union (CDU), Breitenbuch has been serving as member of the Landtag of Saxony since 2009. He is serving as Saxony's State Minister for the Environment and Agriculture since December 19, 2024.
